body.focus: Fix ISSUE-a6b56dc93aa3d2fe (docs/standalone/make-finished-code-review-story-plan-E20261105a6b56dc9/ISSUE.md): re-read a stored task code review of a Story with a Plan against the document set its route required at start, so publish/resume/second start succeed for {lld, plan} (legacy {story, lld, plan} still reads; start-side checks stay strict).
body.summary: pinnedTriple in task-review/packet.ts takes a historical flag: a stored re-read (publication and admission resume) accepts LLD and Plan alone and checks the story document only when it was pinned; a new packet without a route still needs all three. Tests: route-documents.test.ts (re-read parity with start, legacy triple still reads, new packet still refused, missing LLD/Plan and another story refused) and publication.test.ts (a stored {lld, plan} review publishes); both fail without the fix. Left out: the two other items in #100 (retrying a crashed reviewer unit; the design review 'Expected union value' result error). A pre-existing failure in history.test.ts ('all-reuse attempts…') fails without this change too.
